name: DEV SQPERF: all mods
summary: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Turns on the SQPERF debug performance log of every square mod.
description: DEV ONLY - NOT FOR UPLOAD. Never publish this mod. Master switch for the SQPERF performance instrumentation: while it is enabled, every square mod with SQPERF logs as if its own "Debug: performance log" setting were On (30 s summaries and debug-gated lines in stdout.txt). It has no scripts and changes nothing in the game. See plans/sqperf/README.md.
